slice: RPP-5mq consumed MLINE append source counts 33 through 63
scope: Qualifies runtime-generated AC1027 one-element append profiles for consumed MLINESTYLE source counts 33 through 63, producing target counts 34 through 64. The evidence is source-count specific and does not imply full format or document support.

contract.admission: For each source count, the fixture generator emits ordered source tuples using the same deterministic offset, ACI and alternating ByLayer/Continuous linetype patterns, then appends exactly one tuple. Flags are 2 and angles are unchanged. Two source-bound open, uncut and unfilled MLINE consumers use each style.
contract.geometry: Every source MLINE segment parameter is checked against the source minimum; the append recalculates all parameters against the target minimum. Consumer scale, justification, extrusion, vertices, directions, miters, per-element parameter pairs, group-42 absence and area-fill state match the selected geometry profile.
contract.identityAndOutput: Each style retains source identity and emits the exact target group-71 count and ordered tuple data. Unique ByLayer and Continuous LTYPE providers are checked. Both consumers keep the group-340 target and emit group 73 equal to the target count with exact group-74/group-41/group-75 values. Fresh import checks all output fields in model space and a named block.
contract.failureAndRetry: Unsupported style flags and late live-consumer mutation each refuse before publication while preserving destination and caller-state contracts. Corrected state retries on the same adapter for both ASCII and binary output.
contract.compatibility: No public API or DRW_Interface virtual changes. All DXF inputs and outputs are generated at runtime and removed after success; no fixtures are committed.
contract.limits: New evidence is limited to one-element consumed-style appends for counts 33 through 63 under the exact generated source and consumer profiles. Other counts, append batches, removals, MLINE schema/carrier/version variants, native semantics and whole-document closure remain unqualified. No support claim is promoted.

controls.failureAndRetry: Each source count has four output combinations, eight readbacks, two unsupported-flag refusals, two late-mutation refusals and four corrected same-adapter retries.
